nom: The INKEY List 15% Vitamin C & EGF Brightening Serum

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, freckled skin and hormonal/cystic acne reports this serum works well for her without triggering breakouts like others have, and has faded her freckles over time.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, several saying this is one of the few vitamin C serums that doesn't irritate or sting where others were too strong; one exception says that after building up use on her sensitive skin she mainly noticed redness rather than brightening, and remains unsure it's working.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports the serum doesn't add excess oil or dry her skin out, while gently fading dark marks.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin calls the lightweight texture perfect for her skin type.

concerns.spots: Reports on brightening and fading of dark marks, sun spots, or hyperpigmentation are sharply mixed: many reviewers describe visible fading of scars, freckles, sunspots, or age-related discoloration within weeks to a few months, while a comparable number, some after a year or more of use, say they've seen little to no noticeable difference in brightness or spot fading.
concerns.dehydration: Experiences with hydration vary: several reviewers say it doesn't dry out their skin and even improves how well skin holds moisture, while others describe it as drying or skin-tightening on its own, with a couple specifically saying they need to apply moisturizer immediately afterward.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily-prone skin or oil sensitivity report this serum, unlike some other vitamin C serums they've tried, does not add excess shine or oiliness throughout the day.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers who normally break out from vitamin C serums report this one doesn't cause new blemishes, including one managing cystic, hormonal, chin acne who found it easier to tolerate than others she's tried.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin, after building up her use, reports mainly noticing redness rather than any brightening effect.
concerns.aging: A handful of reviewers report improvements related to aging skin — softer fine lines, more firmness, and faded age-related discoloration — though these are secondary mentions alongside the serum's main brightening effect.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenser can be hard to use
Airless packaging keeps it from oxidizing
Can pill under SPF or makeup for some
Requires a wait before layering next product

extraits.texte: Been using this for a month now as part of my skincare routine. I can't say I notice if this has made any difference to my skin or not really. It's quite drying to the skin when I put it on, I definitely feel the need to have moisturiser on straight after. Wouldn't buy it again

Skin Type: Dry, freckles, not too sensitive Acne Type: cystic, hormonal, congested chin This Vit. C serum has been working well for me as others have made me break out. I am almost done with a bottle, and though I do notice brightness, I also use other products in tandem. I am also VERY freckly and it does fade them (so there is proof it works). The only con for me is that it's very liquid-y. I am careful with my layering + I have not had any issues with pilling. I have been mixing a drop of a raw/neutral face oil for a smidge more control with smoothing it on before I move on to heavier serums. I will also say from a clinical perspective; the technology of using EGF along with the vit. c, in addition to the price-point, makes it a no-brainer. Would buy again.

This is a lightweight serum that absorbs into my skin very quickly. The pump disperses enough serum and works well. I brought this vitamin C serum as I have dark marks. After using this serum for the past 3 months I've noticed that my dark marks are fading quicker and my skin is looking brought to. I have combination skin and find this serum does not add excess oil or make my skin dry. I like that the packaging states when to use it (morning and night ). It's gentle on my skin and doesn't irritate it at all. I don't need to use much as a little goes a long way. A lovely addition to my skincare routine.

I have noticed changes on my acne scars and it has brightened skin plus I've noticed with other vitamin c serums for some reason it makes my skin extra oily throughout the day but this doesn't do that at all which I love .
It takes time to build up on sensitive skin. I am not sure if it is working for me. I do not see particularly brightening on my skin, just redness. I use it 3x a week.
I usually get breakouts from vit c, but this worked like pure magic and did not cause me to break out.
It's super light weight, perfect for oily skin. It has an amazing packaging so it doesn't oxidise.
